steps.title: Rkatsiteli and Mtsvane
steps.body: Georgia has over 500 native grape varieties. Rkatsiteli, the most planted white, has high acidity and gives citrus, apple and quince in modern styles, or rich, tannic amber wine in qvevri. Mtsvane Kakhuri, green of Kakheti, is aromatic, with tropical fruit and flowers, often blended with Rkatsiteli. Kisi is another fine white.

steps.title: Saperavi
steps.body: Saperavi, meaning dye or colour, is Georgia's main red. It's a teinturier, with red flesh, giving very deep colour, high acidity and firm tannin, with blackberry, black cherry, plum and spice. It ages well. It makes dry reds, like Mukuzani, and semi-sweet reds, like Kindzmarauli.

steps.prompt: Match each grape to its character.
steps.explanation: Georgia's grapes are native and diverse.

steps.body: Saperavi's red flesh means even its juice is coloured. Its wines can be almost black.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Rkatsiteli and Mtsvane lead the whites
Saperavi is a red-fleshed, deeply coloured red
